response.title: Gho Mala Asala Hawa
response.overview:
Gho Mala Asla Hava is a 2009 Marathi comedy drama starring Radhika Apte,  Nina Kulkarni,  Reema Lagoo and others. 

A farmer's daughter wants to marry the man of her choice not the idiot her father chooses for her. Her heart is set on a fisherman,  Madhu. In order to get rid of her forced suitor she comes up with a plan. It involves manipulating villager's superstitious beliefs and traditions to stop herself from being tied down to a man not worthy of her.
